expert-test-bindings.title: Independent test tools
expert-test-bindings.intro: Review test choices only when needed. Each task keeps its own exact configuration; published workflow and acceptance rules remain unchanged.
expert-test-bindings.retain_help: Keep this item's fixed choices. A new item uses the published definition. The server rechecks current tools and routes when previewing or revising.
expert-test-bindings.source_changed: The role, workflow or developer identity changed. Explicitly choose replacements or restore the published definition; old choices cannot be silently inherited.
expert-test-bindings.definition_help: Explicitly remove this item's test overrides and use its published workflow definition. This does not prove independent test execution.
expert-test-bindings.adjust_help: Select every override to keep in the replacement set. Unselected test steps use the published definition; another Worker is required.
expert-test-bindings.started: This item has started. Its saved test choices are read-only.
expert-test-bindings.inputs_changed: The exact published workflow or developer tool is unavailable or changed. Refresh the role configuration before choosing tests.
